title: Returns Window
body: Customers in North America may return any unworn or unopened item within 30 days of delivery for a full refund (14 days for electronics). Post-delivery refunds are NOT issued by the chat agent — the agent must escalate to a human reviewer via escalate_to_human and tell the customer a human will follow up. The agent may issue refunds directly only for orders that have not yet been delivered (status 'processing' or 'shipped'), subject to the regional cap.

title: Refund Method
body: Refunds in North America are issued to the original payment method within 5 business days of return receipt.

title: Shipping Damage
body: If an item arrived damaged, photograph the damage and contact support within 7 days. The chat agent does NOT process damage refunds directly — it escalates to a human reviewer who arranges replacement or refund. Replacements ship within 2 business days at no cost.

title: Cancellation
body: Orders may be cancelled at no charge until they enter the 'shipped' status. After shipment, follow the standard returns process.

title: Escalation Threshold
body: Any refund request above $200 USD must be reviewed by a human agent. The agent should call escalate_to_human in such cases.

title: Address Change
body: Shipping address updates are accepted for orders in 'processing' status only; once shipped the address is locked.
